meta.title: Privacy policy — Chalet Yolo
meta.description: Privacy policy of the Chalet Yolo website: contact form data, no cookies, cookie-free analytics, your rights.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: [À FOURNIR] (company name, address and contact email).

sections.title: Data collected
paragraphs: When you use the contact form, we receive the information you enter: name, email, phone, stay dates, number of adults and children, children's ages, requested services and message.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
paragraphs: This data is used solely to respond to your stay enquiry.
It is processed on the basis of your consent, given by ticking the box provided in the form.

sections.title: Recipients and hosting
paragraphs: Enquiries sent through the form are received and stored by our hosting provider Netlify, Inc., a company based in the United States.
Safeguards for this transfer outside the European Union: [À FOURNIR]

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not set any cookies.
The map on the Méribel page, provided by OpenStreetMap, only loads if you click “Show the map”.

sections.title: Audience measurement
paragraphs: If audience measurement is enabled, the website uses Umami, an analytics tool that works without cookies.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data.
To exercise these rights: [À FOURNIR] (contact email).
You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (the French data protection authority): https://www.cnil.fr
